title: XPress: Parallel Refinement for Diffusion Drafters in Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2608.02438v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Block-diffusion drafters like dFlash generate an entire block of draft tokens in a single forward pass, drastically reducing the overhead of multiple-token drafting in speculative decoding. The crucial final step of the single-pass discrete denoising process involves using the logit distribution at each position to sample conditionally independent tokens. The resulting draft is thus a set of per-position marginals, rather than a joint distribution: no draft token is guaranteed to depend on its predecessors. Such independently sampled marginals tend to produce sequences with tokens that are individually likely, but jointly improbable under the target model's distribution, which verifies each token conditionally. This can cause early rejection and limits acceptance length. To address this, we propose xPress as a means to restore the missing causality in diffusion drafters. xPress is a lightweight causal refiner that reconciles the whol

translated_title: XPress：推测解码中扩散起草器的并行精炼方法
translated_abstract: 诸如 dFlash 等块扩散起草器（block-diffusion drafters）能够在单次前向传播中生成整块草稿词元，大幅降低了推测解码中多词元起草的开销。单次离散去噪过程的关键最后一步，是利用每个位置的 logit 分布来采样条件独立的词元。因此，所得草稿是一组逐位置的边缘分布，而非联合分布：没有任何草稿词元被保证依赖于其前驱词元。这种独立采样的边缘分布倾向于产生这样的词元序列：每个词元单独看都可能性较高，但在目标模型（其以条件方式逐词元验证）的分布下联合起来却不太可能出现。这会导致过早拒绝并限制接受长度。为解决这一问题，我们提出 xPress，用以恢复扩散起草器中缺失的因果性。xPress 是一个轻量级的因果精炼器，它协调了整体……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 xPress——一个轻量级因果精炼器，通过在扩散起草器的独立采样草稿中恢复缺失的词元间因果依赖，避免草稿因“单独合理但联合不可能”而被目标模型过早拒绝，从而提升推测解码的接受长度。
en_tdlr: XPress is a lightweight causal refiner that restores the missing inter-token causality in diffusion drafters' independently sampled drafts, preventing early rejection of jointly improbable sequences and increasing acceptance length in speculative decoding.
